It is located very close to Vianden Castle, and we happened to stop by at the last minute to order food. La qualité des plats est extraordinaire : chaque assiette est préparée avec soin, des ingrédients frais et un goût authentique, sincère, fait avec passion. On ressent immédiatement l’attention portée aux détails et l’amour de la cuisine.

Mais ce qui rend ce restaurant vraiment spécial, c’est l’atmosphère : Carlos et son épouse sont d’une gentillesse et d’une sympathie rares. Ils vous accueillent toujours avec le sourire et font en sorte que chaque client se sente comme un invité privilégié, et non comme un simple client.

Un équilibre parfait entre saveur, qualité et chaleur humaine. Toutes nos félicitations, continuez ainsi !

google_reviews.author: Valentijn
google_reviews.text:
The price–quality ratio at this sushi restaurant was genuinely excellent. I chose the all‑you‑can‑eat menu and, while the selection was somewhat limited compared to larger sushi spots, the quality more than made up for it. Everything tasted fresh, well prepared, and carefully balanced, with none of the usual compromises you sometimes expect from an all‑you‑can‑eat concept.
The restaurant itself was very quiet during my visit, but this was clearly no issue for the kitchen at all. The dishes came out with care and consistency, and it felt as though full attention was given to each order. I ended up enjoying the meal far more than expected, precisely because of that calm, unhurried atmosphere combined with such solid execution.
Good sushi restaurants are relatively rare in Luxembourg, which makes this place stand out even more. If you’re looking for great value, good‑quality sushi, and a relaxed dining experience, this restaurant is absolutely worth recommending.

google_reviews.text:
If you're looking to escape the sterile atmosphere of modern life, Villa de Jade is a true gem. The moment you step inside, you're instantly transported back to the 1970s.
Why we love it:
* The Decor: Everything has been preserved in its original state, with a rare authenticity that gives the place its charm. It's an immediate visual journey.

* The Food: You'll rediscover traditional cuisine, faithful to the recipes of the era. The dishes are generous, well-prepared, and consistently excellent.

* The Atmosphere: A warm and welcoming atmosphere prevails. You simply feel at ease.

* The Service: Discreet and efficient, the staff ensures a smooth experience without ever being intrusive. It's the perfect place to relive nostalgic memories over dinner. You come for the nostalgia, you stay for the quality and warmth of the welcome. A must-visit address in Ettelbruck for lovers of authenticity!

Un très bel endroit dans la campagne. Avec une vue magnifique sur le château de Bouscheid. De nombreuses balades partent de l'hôtel pour visiter la région.
Un piscine à le bonne température et un spa à la hauteur du standing de l'hôtel.
Pensez a réserver vos soins et votre transat.
Une demi-pension au top en 5 services.
Pour moi la voie rapide est un peu proche mais les chambres sont a l'opposé du bruit et la nuit vous n'entendez pas la route.
Le spa actuel propose une piscine et des espaces intérieur et extérieur.
L'hôtel Leweck est en construction d'une nouvelle extension de 38 chambres et d'un tout nouveau SPA wellmess. Nous reviendrons avec plaisir.

google_reviews.author: Benjamin Linus
google_reviews.text:
Wir waren mit Freunden hier, um einen entspannten Wellness-Tag zu verbringen – leider wurde daraus eine große Enttäuschung.

Positiv hervorzuheben sind lediglich der freundliche Empfang sowie das nette Personal an der Poolbar. Der eigentliche Wellnessbereich hingegen weist gravierende Mängel auf. Es fehlen grundlegende Standards, vieles ist nicht beschildert, wirkt defekt oder unhygienisch. Eine regelmäßige Reinigung scheint kaum stattzufinden; außer dem Auffüllen der Becher in der Sauna war davon nichts zu bemerken.

Von Privatsphäre und Erholung kann keine Rede sein. Gäste springen mit Arschbomben in den Pool, schreien laut herum und laufen mit Straßenschuhen durch den Poolbereich – ohne dass Personal einschreitet oder überhaupt präsent ist. Besonders irritierend: Durch ein Fenster kann man vom Pool direkt in den Saunabereich sehen, ebenso hat man von der Poolbar aus Einsicht in die Toiletten. Das wirkt äußerst befremdlich und unangenehm.

Auch die Sauberkeit ist ein großes Problem. Im Sauna-, Dusch- und Umkleidebereich lagen den gesamten Tag benutzte Hand- und Badetücher auf dem Boden. Die Duschen wirkten ungepflegt, die Dampfsauna war innen verschimmelt und es gab nicht einmal einen Schlauch zum Reinigen. Regelmäßige Kontrollen oder Sicherheitsmaßnahmen fehlen komplett – nicht einmal ein Notruf- oder Hilfeknopf ist vorhanden. In Zeiten, in denen viele Wellnessanlagen verstärkt auf Sicherheit und Schutz der Gäste achten, ist das erschreckend.

Zusätzlich werden für Handtücher extra Gebühren verlangt, obwohl diese nicht einmal regelmäßig gewechselt werden. Eine entspannende Atmosphäre kommt ebenfalls nicht auf – selbst leise Hintergrundmusik oder ein angenehmes Wellness-Ambiente fehlen völlig.

Das Abendessen im Restaurant war durchschnittlich. Der Service dagegen unprofessionell und teilweise unfreundlich. Teller wurden ungeschickt direkt am Gesicht vorbeigetragen, der Sommelier fasste wiederholt mit den Fingern an die offene Weinflasche – unhygienisch und unangenehm. Zudem waren die Teller am Buffet teilweise nicht sauber. Das Servicepersonal erklärte nichts, fragte kaum nach und bot am Ende nicht einmal Kaffee an.

Insgesamt war dies eine enttäuschende und viel zu teure Erfahrung. Hier stimmt vieles nicht mehr – und den zahlreichen negativen Bewertungen scheint offenbar ebenfalls keine Bedeutung beigemessen zu werden.

Zudem waren die Teller am Buffet teilweise nicht sauber. Das Servicepersonal erklärte nichts, fragte kaum nach und bot am Ende nicht einmal Kaffee an.

Insgesamt war dies eine enttäuschende und viel zu teure Erfahrung. Hier stimmt vieles nicht mehr – und den zahlreichen negativen Bewertungen scheint offenbar ebenfalls keine Bedeutung beigemessen zu werden.

reviews.author: 1 Paja
reviews.text_en: Pleasant and quiet campsite by the river. Beautiful view of the castle. Swimming in the river and good beer. Accommodation in a wooden cabin for 4 people without any complaints. Reasonable price.

google_reviews.author: Chris Bill
google_reviews.text: The campsite is beautifully situated. It lies beside the Sur River in a valley and is accessible via two roads. The western access road is steep and winds its way up the hill. A footbridge crosses the river. In warm weather, the river is inviting for a swim. Bourscheid Castle can be seen in the valley below, perched on a hill. We have been visiting this campsite for over 10 years. Last year, the ownership changed. Unfortunately, this year we had our first negative experience. The outdated sanitary facilities are only inadequately cleaned. Hot water is often unavailable. The sanitary area is not lit at night. Taps are missing from the faucets. Loud music is played from the afternoon until late in the evening. The once quiet and idyllic campsite has transformed into a beach club. The owners are rude and offer little in the way of customer service. Our electricity connection was intermittently unreliable.

google_reviews.author: Kim Angkana
google_reviews.text: Unbelievable. We've been coming here for years, and the new owners are really going overboard. We're not even allowed to play a little music anymore. Music playing over an iPhone is deemed "loud." We're not allowed to use a table anymore, which we always could. We're not allowed to do anything here at all! The owners are so petty. I'm definitely never coming back here. My family has been coming here for 30 years...

google_reviews.author: Moh Far
google_reviews.text:
I went there as a hiker so I don't have experience with services for campers. But for a hiker, the location is very beautiful, the toilets and showers were very clean, and the personnel were friendly.
I strongly suggest, specially if you're doing the Lee trail.

google_reviews.author: Jose Versleijen
google_reviews.text: Great campsite, have been coming here for years

google_reviews.author: Lise Burton
google_reviews.text: The meat wasn't fresh and was undercooked, the service was unpleasant and very slow. Avoid at all costs.

google_reviews.author: Lisa Baijense
google_reviews.text: The price-quality ratio is disproportionate. The food is expensive for what you get. The food itself is fine, but not great. There is no background music, so it is very quiet when it is calm.

google_reviews.text: A beautiful, small hotel with a family atmosphere and a very friendly owner who is always attentive to the needs and wishes of her guests. There are charming hiking trails and castles nearby. I recommend the dinner package; the chef cooks with imagination and flavor.

Because of the Bongo voucher, we didn't have a view of the water but were moored right against a rock, which wasn't very pleasant, but otherwise everything was fine.

google_reviews.author: Sonja Schilfhexe
google_reviews.text: Very peaceful and close to nature. Perfect for slowing down with hiking, fishing, cycling, and exploring the surroundings. Stunning natural scenery, simply idyllic. Furthermore, the entire site is beautifully landscaped, with lovely little front gardens in front of the houses, showcasing a love of plants and a talent for arrangement.

google_reviews.author: Moh Far
google_reviews.text:
I spent a night there while doing the Lee trails. The reception closes by 8 pm so make sure to reach on time.
The hikers' lodge, where I stayed, is in a nice and quite corner.
The location is very beautiful, the showers and toilets are clean, but make sure to have bring your snack because the options are extremely limited.
For hikers, I definitely suggest.

google_reviews.author: Laurent Beckers
google_reviews.text: Well done!!!

google_reviews.author: Jean-Louis Sterckx
google_reviews.text: This place is amazing! The food is great and so is the vibe. 10/10 recommended!! Loved it ♥️

google_reviews.author: Yoshi
google_reviews.text: Amazing food with kind staff , will definitely order again !

google_reviews.author: Michael De Groeve
google_reviews.text: Deliciously prepared and with incredibly friendly service. Good explanation of the fried snacks.

google_reviews.author: Lotte Jespers
google_reviews.text: We found this camping spot via Welcome To My Garden! After a hot and tough second leg of the Lee Trail, Cafe Beim Anette turned out to be a godsend 🤩 We were able to feast on homemade pasta bolognese by Anette together with other hikers 🫶🏼, were allowed to use the garden hose for heavenly refreshment, and pitched our tent in a cozy garden that even provided chairs and a campfire area. In short: we couldn't have asked for better. Thanks!

google_reviews.author: Teun V
google_reviews.text:
What a welcoming reception on the terrace at Cafe beim Annette after the tough 2nd stage of the LEEtrail.
And a beautiful spot to pitch our tents 'in the meadow'. A lovely beer on the terrace, a tasty 'daily special', and ending the day with a drink by the campfire. Perfect.

google_reviews.author: Alex Dosser (AlxDsr)
google_reviews.text: Top quite underrated hike trail.  View is spectacular. It goes straight through the biggest burned forrest area of luxembourg. You can still see black trunks. There is a bench . Only for good hikers with propper equipment elsewhere it can be dangerous . Not recommended with bad weather. In the valley is an easy asphalt way. back to goebelsmillen..

google_reviews.author: Tamara Lee
google_reviews.text: A fantastic hike from Schlindermanderscheid, it took me about 3 hours for the route. "Hoflee" was of course the highlight of the hike; you need a certain level of fitness (or not, but it would be an advantage). In any case, it's a worthwhile hike with breathtaking views from both sides (sturdy shoes are a must). Not suitable for small children or people with limited mobility.

google_reviews.author: Tom Dutch
google_reviews.text: A challenging climb for experienced hikers with good fitness and sure-footedness. Caution: the slate is slippery in rain! Includes an alpine section of approximately 550 meters. Starting from Kautenbach, the ascent is approximately 180 meters over a distance of 2 km (from 270 m to 450 m), with a section of over 25% gradient. 360° panoramic views of the Wiltz and the railway line. A forest fire ravaged this rocky ridge in 2018.

google_reviews.author: verwijmeren mad
google_reviews.text:
Super cozy and local.
An extreme variety of whisky, and not for the connoisseurs! But also very nice house wine, rosé, white, and red.

google_reviews.author: Myrthe Boeijenga
google_reviews.text: Great food, good service and reasonable prices.

google_reviews.author: Stefi Bosmans
google_reviews.text: Good food, only I would like the service to be a bit faster, and certainly in German

google_reviews.author: Bhyman Saeed
google_reviews.text:
The campsite it’s lovely and the server and reception guy were super friendly HOWEVER the “Manager/Owner” or whoever the old lady is - is ridiculously rude and extremely racist !

She has no decorum no experience with costumer service and no hospitality  and should not be client facing.

We booked tent grounds for 2 nights - the place is lovely (although deffo recommend bringing a partial or some sort of shade because it’s very open and practically no shade- the bathroom/ kitchen facilities were fairly clean and well kept.

Onto the weird -
we had ordered bread for the next day and paid at this shop but were not aware it had to be picked up before 11:30 the next day -

The next day we went for lunch at the bistro around midday and the food was not amazing but the server was lovely - after asking for a plug to charge our phones we were informed that the manager was “weird “ and didn’t like people asking for things  - after lunch we asked at reception about the bread and were told the bread was already finished for the day- the receptionist approached this “manager/owner” to see if there was bread in the bistro or what could be done to which she got extremely irritated and started shouting about we should have been on time and there was nothing she to do etc despite us having pre-paid - the receptionist was mortified so we just let it go and just walked away.

Later in the evening my husband went to the bistro which still had people in it and sitting on the terrace and asked if he could buy a cup of tea and the same “manager” got aggressive  and told him the bistro was closed and tried to usher him through the other door (different from where he went in) when he tried to explain he needed to go through the door he came in she started acting scared and approached some people siting on the terrace and repeating that he had to leave (even though he was already leaving).

I honestly don’t know what’s wrong with her but this place would be much better without her.
Shame she ruined this experience for us and we will not be coming back.

google_reviews.author: EinsteinBike on Tour
google_reviews.text:
A beautiful campsite nestled in a valley with a babbling brook, surrounded by natural forests on rugged mountain slopes. A dream for nature lovers, and dogs are welcome.

There are numerous pitches, a tent area, and several cabins. The sanitary facilities are in good condition, and there is also a well-stocked kiosk and a restaurant.

google_reviews.author: Joanna Bulbiak
google_reviews.text: A beautiful and atmospheric place, we recommend it.
